brand_assets_dimensions_check.name: brand_assets_dimensions_check
brand_assets_dimensions_check.value: ("brand_assets"."width" is null or "brand_assets"."width" > 0) and ("brand_assets"."height" is null or "brand_assets"."height" > 0)

salvos próprios.name: salvos próprios
salvos próprios.using: "idea_saves"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "ideas" where "ideas"."id" = "idea_saves"."idea_id" and public.is_store_member("ideas"."store_id"))
salvos próprios.withCheck: "idea_saves"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "ideas" where "ideas"."id" = "idea_saves"."idea_id" and public.is_store_member("ideas"."store_id"))

public.store_art_usage.definition: select "subscriptions"."store_id", count("art_usage"."id")::int as "arts_used", "subscriptions"."trial_art_limit" from "subscriptions" left join "art_usage" on "art_usage"."store_id" = "subscriptions"."store_id" group by "subscriptions"."store_id", "subscriptions"."trial_art_limit"
public.store_art_usage.name: store_art_usage
